## Service Catalog

### 1. Web Development
- **URL:** https://maajankiwebtech.com/services/web-development
- **Description:** We build high-performance, SEO-optimized, mobile-responsive websites using modern frameworks including Next.js 14, React, and WordPress. We specialize in custom e-commerce stores (WooCommerce, Shopify), SaaS dashboards, and business landing pages.
- **Technologies:** Next.js, React, WordPress, WooCommerce, Shopify, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap
- **Deliverables:** Custom website, CMS setup, hosting deployment, SSL, domain configuration, Google Analytics/Search Console integration
- **Turnaround:** 7-14 business days (standard sites), 4-8 weeks (complex apps)

### 2. Search Engine Optimization (SEO)
- **URL:** https://maajankiwebtech.com/services/seo
- **Description:** Comprehensive SEO services including technical audits, local SEO, Google Business Profile optimization, keyword research, on-page optimization, link building, and monthly performance reporting.
- **Sub-services:** Technical SEO Audit, Local SEO, On-Page SEO, Off-Page SEO, Google Business Profile Management, Schema Markup Implementation, Core Web Vitals Optimization
- **Target Markets:** Local businesses in Bihar, national brands across India, international clients in USA/UK/Canada/Australia

### 3. Performance Marketing & Paid Ads
- **URL:** https://maajankiwebtech.com/services/performance-marketing
- **Description:** Data-driven paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads (Search, Display, Shopping), Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram), and LinkedIn Ads. We manage budgets from ₹10,000/month to ₹10,00,000+/month with full conversion tracking and ROI reporting.
- **Platforms:** Google Ads, Facebook Ads, Instagram Ads, LinkedIn Ads
- **Tracking:** GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, Conversion API

### 4. Social Media Optimization (SMO)
- **URL:** https://maajankiwebtech.com/services/smo
- **Description:** Brand promotion, content creation, community management, and audience growth across social media platforms. We handle everything from profile setup to daily posting, hashtag strategy, and engagement analytics.
- **Platforms:** Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Pinterest, YouTube

### 5. Branding & Visual Identity
- **URL:** https://maajankiwebtech.com/services/branding
- **Description:** Complete brand identity design including logo design, brand guidelines, color palette, typography selection, brand voice documentation, and marketing collateral design.
- **Deliverables:** Logo (all formats), Brand Style Guide, Business Cards, Letterhead, Social Media Kit, Brand Presentation

### 6. UI/UX Design
- **URL:** https://maajankiwebtech.com/services/ui-ux-design
- **Description:** User-centric interface design with wireframing, interactive prototyping, usability testing, and design system creation. We design for web, mobile, and SaaS products.
- **Tools:** Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch

### 7. Content Writing
- **URL:** https://maajankiwebtech.com/services/content-writing
- **Description:** SEO-optimized content writing for websites, blogs, product descriptions, landing pages, and email campaigns. All content is original, researched, and aligned with target keywords.
- **Types:** Website Copy, Blog Articles, Product Descriptions, Email Sequences, Social Media Captions

### 8. Graphic Design
- **URL:** https://maajankiwebtech.com/services/graphic-design
- **Description:** Professional graphic design for digital and print media including social media creatives, banners, flyers, brochures, infographics, and presentation designs.

### 9. E-Commerce Product Listing
- **URL:** https://maajankiwebtech.com/services/products-listing
- **Description:** Product cataloging and listing optimization for major e-commerce platforms. We handle product photography, description writing, keyword optimization, and A+ content creation.
- **Platforms:** Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Shopify, WooCommerce

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What services does MaaJanki Web Tech offer?**
A: We offer web development (WordPress, React, Next.js), SEO, performance marketing, SMO, branding, UI/UX design, content writing, graphic design, and e-commerce product listing.

**Q: How much does a website cost?**
A: Pricing depends on project scope. Standard business websites start at competitive rates. Contact us at +91-9006543913 for a free quote.

**Q: Do you work with international clients?**
A: Yes, we serve clients in the USA, UK, Canada, Australia, UAE, Nepal, and Japan alongside our Indian client base.

**Q: How long does website development take?**
A: Standard websites: 7-14 business days. Complex web apps: 4-8 weeks.

**Q: Do you provide website maintenance?**
A: Yes, we offer monthly maintenance including security audits, content updates, server monitoring, and technical support.
